title: Washington Fishing Year
what: Calendar, river map and migration timing for the Seattle fishing year, Oct 2026 to Nov 2027. Dated seasons and rules are artifact-only guidance sourced from WDFW notices; the app never reads them.
note: Published as year/ inside the Washington Fishing Map (Artifacts/salmon-rivers/year/), which carries the shared tab bar. Refresh by updating Artifacts/salmon-rivers/year/ and publishing the main URL with those files. Edit seasons.json, run scripts/build_fishing_year.py (writes data.js, fails on bad data), run node check.mjs in this folder (type scale, contrast, tap targets, scroll, console; --selftest proves the checks fire), then refresh by PASSING THIS URL with file_path=index.html and files={data.js}. index.html is the built page and holds no data. Omitting the URL mints a second artifact. Before publishing, read the live version: an edit made outside the repo (2026-10-18, Skagit emergency rule WSR 26-21-045 and the Snohomish closure) was published straight to the page and had to be copied into seasons.json first.
synced: 2026-10-20: version 1792455540-4ddb (published outside the repo, Green River timing note and Three Friends stop note) was copied into seasons.json; the rebuilt data.js is byte-identical to the live one.
